Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10th - June 20th, 2024

Essential Items:
- Swimwear
- Sunscreen (SPF 50+ recommended)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable clothing)
- Camera
- Travel documents (passport, ID, hotel confirmations)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Beach towel
- Reef-safe sunscreen (required for Hanauma Bay)
- Water shoes for snorkeling
- Light rain jacket (for potential showers)
- Hat and sunglasses
- Insect repellent
- Reusable water bottle
- Flip flops/sandals
- Evening attire (for the Luau)
- Snorkel gear (optional, can be rented)
- Waterproof phone case
- Travel adapter (if needed)
- Medications
- Cash and credit cards
